name: Sen no Hatou, Tsukisome no Kouki -Hana Akari-
original_name: 千の刃濤、桃花染の皇姫 -花あかり-
source: This is the fandisc for Sen no Hatou, Tsukisome no Kouki.  featuring after stories for all heroines. Also includes new stories for side-characters[spoiler] Isuzu, Chihaya, Himi no Mikoto and Sekka[/spoiler].
translation: 本作是《千之刃涛、桃花染之皇姬》的后日谈合集，收录了所有女主角的后续故事，还为配角[spoiler]五十铃、千波矢、绯弥之命和雪花[/spoiler]增添了全新故事。
